fundamental.name: Premium Plast Ltd
pros: Stock is trading at 1.14 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 55.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 82.5 days to 60.9 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 47, DCF overvalued 107%. Even with a decent story, a lot of optimism is already in the price.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).
